item.title: Queen of the Fruits: Mangosteen (Garcinia mangostana) - Ethnoagriculture
item.description: Mangosteen has been a big interest of mine this past summer, and I’ve had a good time researching it. Mangosteen is a tropical plant with a sweet, tangy flavor and vibrant purple rind, with therapeutic potential, cultivated in Southeast Asia.
